source.author: verg
source.text: Aenean acciri omnes, populusque patresque, exposcunt mittique viros, qui certa reportent.
source.text_original: Aenean acciri omnes, populusque patresque, / exposcunt mittique viros, qui certa reportent.
source.text_english: They all call for Aeneas to be summoned, both the people and the elders, and they demand that men be sent who may bring back definite news.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: populumne levem veterique tyranno infensum atque olim miserantes Aesona patres advocet?
reuse.text_original: populumne levem veterique tyranno / infensum atque olim miserantes Aesona patres / advocet?
reuse.text_english: Should he summon a fickle people, hostile to the old tyrant, and the fathers of Aeson, who long ago had pity?
